account: It is ten in the morning on day 0, and I have reached the plaza for my scheduled market walk. Townsfolk 10, 20, and 30 are here. I asked Townsfolk 30 for news, and they said they had none. I have not observed evidence of any unusual town activity or secret undertaking. The one uncertainty is my three o'clock appointment: the book lists tea with a neighbour at a dockside cottage on the east bank but gives no precise address. The secretary says no invitation or correspondence has arrived identifying the cottage. I returned the original appointment book to its chest and subsequently saw the secretary take it out. The secretary is now approaching the plaza; I do not know why. These may all be ordinary arrangements, and I have no basis yet to attribute a hidden purpose to them. My remaining engagements today are lunch at home at noon, office accounts at one, dockside tea at three, office at four-thirty, and home at seven.
